description: A panel of six switches that sets the jumpers of an RKD placed immediately to its left or its right, so the circuit board never has to be opened

params.text: COUNTING to the right, under the down arrow, makes the RKD count down-beat, with all eight outputs firing together on the first clock pulse; to the left they count up-beat
TRIG. GATE to the right makes the RKD hold a gate on each output; to the left it sends a short trigger
One of the two MAX DIV switches: with both to the right the largest divider is 8, with both to the left it is 64, and with this one alone to the left it is 16
One of the two MAX DIV switches: with both to the right the largest divider is 8, with both to the left it is 64, and with this one alone to the left it is 32
SPREAD to ON spreads the RKD's dividers across the whole range the MAX DIV switches allow; to OFF they bunch at the low end
AUTO-RESET to ON makes the RKD reset itself every time twice the largest divider has been counted

notes: this panel does nothing unless an RKD is placed against it, on either side, with no gap; it has no jacks, no lamps and no power draw
with an RKD on both sides the one on the right is driven and the one on the left is left alone
the switch positions are copied into the RKD's jumpers every sample, so the RKD's own jumpers cannot be moved by hand while this panel is attached
MAX DIV and SPREAD reach the RKD only while it is using its Manufacturer dividers table; the other four tables ignore both
once the RKD is set the way you need it, this panel can be removed and the setting stays
